title: Workspace Settings
subtitle: {{name}} · Manage knowledge, services, observability stacks, and workspace members.

stacks_section.title: Observability Stacks
stacks_section.description: Prometheus/Tempo/Alertmanager stacks owned by this workspace — used by the watchdog for automatic triage.

notifications_section.title: Notifications
notifications_section.description: Notification channels (Telegram) owned by this workspace — link them to projects on the project page; incident reports are sent to the linked bot/chat.

members_section.title: Workspace Members
members_section.description: Invite members and manage their roles in this workspace.

remove_confirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove_confirm.description: {{name}} will lose access to this workspace. They can be invited back anytime.

observability.intro: Just fill in Prometheus/Tempo/Alertmanager URLs — agent & watchdog automatically check these URLs (polling per interval), no .env changes needed. Optional: enable webhook push for real-time alerts (<5s).
observability.empty: No registered stacks yet — watchdog uses global config (.env).
observability.probe_title: Probe Prometheus/Tempo/Alertmanager connection of this stack
observability.rotate_confirm_desc: The old webhook token becomes invalid immediately. Client Alertmanagers still using the old token will fail to send until the new snippet is installed. The new snippet appears after rotation.
observability.delete_confirm_desc: This observability stack will be removed from the monitoring list. The watchdog will no longer use this stack's Prometheus/Tempo/Alertmanager.
observability.create_description: Register your workspace's Prometheus/Alertmanager/Tempo/Loki endpoints. Test each endpoint before saving; after creation, copy the alertmanager.yml snippet (token shown only once).
observability.url_prefix_hint: URL must start with http:// or https://
observability.name_min_hint: Name must be at least 3 characters
observability.otel_intro: Central Log is the primary OTel log source (span_logs/http_logs) used by the Span agent for trace detail and recent errors. One stack per workspace; link projects to scope it.
observability.otel_check_db_missing: Server reachable, but database "{{db}}" was not found.
observability.otel_missing_hint: Fill in the connection URI and database name first
observability.edit_description: Update stack configuration. Kind cannot be changed.
observability.webhook_label: Webhook push real-time (optional — requires pasting the snippet into the client's alertmanager.yml; without it automatic polling still runs)
observability.link_projects_hint: {{count}} project(s) linked — stack will monitor these projects

snippet.title: Alertmanager snippet — {{name}}
snippet.description: Paste into the client's alertmanager.yml. Token is shown ONLY once — save it before closing this dialog.

channels.empty: No channels yet — add a Telegram bot or SMTP email so incident reports get delivered.
channels.description: Incident alerts are sent to every matching channel (project-linked ∪ workspace-wide). Credentials are stored encrypted in the database and never shown again.
channels.create_desc_telegram: Bot token is validated via getMe — must be valid before saving. After creating, link it to projects from the project page.
channels.create_desc_email: SMTP connection is validated before saving. After creating, link it to projects from the project page.
channels.edit_desc_telegram: Leave token empty to keep the existing one.
channels.edit_desc_email: Leave password empty to keep the existing one.
channels.no_channel_hint: No channels — add one in Workspace Settings → Notifications.
channels.still_linked_confirm: Channel is still linked to projects: {{names}}. Delete anyway? (all links will be removed)
channels.still_linked_desc: This will remove all project links for this channel.
channels.telegram_token_keep_hint: leave blank to keep existing token

bindings.no_channel_hint: No channels yet — create one above
bindings.linked_only_hint: Linked channels only send incidents for this project; without a link = all projects.
